authenticity.captureDescription: Paired Apple Watch SE 3 (40mm), watchOS 26.5 Simulator; current WatchRecordingView unlocked with an existing-paid-entitlement fixture; actual synchronized daily counts resisted=3, smoked=2; 324x394 pixel capture.
authenticity.rendering: render_watch.mjs embeds exact real capture proportionally into one drawn watch frame with marketing copy outside the screen; no UI or number repaint.
authenticity.visualMatch: Gray clock band; independent green left and red right rounded recording buttons with centered daily counts only; no on-screen action words, icons, history, graphs or settings. Marketing labels outside Watch identify actions.
authenticity.purchaseNotice: All eight official Watch marketing PNGs disclose a paid feature; currently available with existing Remove Ads or Extra Brands purchase rights per implementation docs.
limitations: Simulator asset and local implementation checks do not establish physical Watch behavior, Store purchase/restore, or App Store publication.
English/German localized Watch marketing images were not present. Use language-neutral actual Watch UI for these languages or clearly acknowledge existing Japanese artwork fallback.
